Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: At step 4, WebSurfer surfaced a Find a Grave snippet indicating “Forest Lawn Memorial Park – Hollywood Hills” and did not open or verify authoritative sources (e.g., the full Wikipedia or Find a Grave pages) to reconcile this with other sources that list “Forest Lawn Memorial Park (Glendale).” The agent repeatedly relied on SERP snippets and reran the same query without resolving the discrepancy, failing to prioritize authoritative verification. This behavior risked (and would directly lead to) selecting the wrong cemetery instead of the correct “Forest Lawn Memorial Park.”
